proposals.before: Emperor Wen asked why; he answered, "When Prince Guang was still unmarried he was always at Your Majesty's side; the day he married he went out to his own residence at once.
proposals.after: Emperor Wen asked why; he answered, "When the Prince of Han was still unmarried he was always at Your Majesty's side; the day he married he went out to his own residence at once.
proposals.reason: 漢王 is the Prince of Han (Yang Liang), not “Prince Guang.”

proposals.before: An edict ordered Vice Director of the Palace Secretariat Yu Shiji to compose a lamentation for the funerary book, which read: On the twenty-third day of the first month of the seventh month in the second year of Daye, cyclical day guichou, the crown prince died at the traveling palace.
proposals.after: An edict ordered Vice Director of the Palace Secretariat Yu Shiji to compose a lamentation for the funerary book, which read: In the second year of Daye, on the twenty-third day of the seventh month, whose first day was guichou, the crown prince died at the traveling palace.
proposals.reason: 七月癸丑朔二十三日 means the twenty-third day of the seventh lunar month, whose first day was guichou; it does not contain a “first month.”

proposals.after: Duan Da was made Director of the Chancellery, General-in-Chief of the Right Wing Guards, and acting Minister of Rites; Wang Shichong likewise Director of the Chancellery, General-in-Chief of the Left Wing Guards, and acting Minister of Personnel; Yuan Wendu Director of the Palace Secretariat and General-in-Chief of the Left Martial Cavalry; Lu Chu also Director of the Palace Secretariat; Huangfu Wuyi Minister of War and General-in-Chief of the Right Martial Guards; Guo Wenyi Vice Director of the Palace Secretariat; Zhao Changwen Vice Director of the Yellow Gate. proposals.reason: 郭文懿內史侍郎 and 趙長文黃門侍郎 assign two distinct vice-director offices; the current idiomatic text collapses them into a shared generic title.

decisions.reason: s0008 has 漢王未婚時; 漢王 is the Prince of Han, and “Prince Guang” is unsupported by the Chinese.
七月癸丑朔二十三日 is day 23 of the seventh month whose first day was guichou; 朔 marks the month-first day, not a separate “first month.”
五月庚辰朔六日 is day 6 of the fifth month whose first day was gengchen; the literal wrongly inserts a nonexistent “first month.”
燕王倓字仁安 has no meta-aside about title repetition; removing “the text repeats the title” restores the Chinese and the comma continuation into s0096.
郭文懿內史侍郎 and 趙長文黃門侍郎 name two distinct offices; collapsing both to generic “vice directors” omits the Chinese titles.

decisions.reason: In context of Zheng (暕), 出入王家 means coming and going at the prince’s residence; “Wang residence” wrongly treats 王 as the concubine’s surname.
趙王杲，小字季子 supports “Prince Gao of Zhao, childhood name Jizi”; the literal invents a title-repetition aside and misorders the name.
The Chinese unit ends at 季子。 and s0248 begins a new independent sentence; a trailing comma leaves a broken English fragment, so terminal punctuation is required.
常見帝風動不進膳 specifies a wind affliction (風動), not merely generic unwellness; the proposed wording restores that illness detail.
願聽嘗炷 asks to try the moxa cone first; culinary “taste” misreads 嘗 here, and “test” matches the trial sense already set by 試炷 in s0253.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0001 shows “Prince Guang” exists only in the bad idiomatic; s0008 has 漢王, so this alternate-name claim has no source support.
